description: This file defines the BasketService class, which provides methods for managing shopping basket operations such as adding items, setting quantities, transferring baskets, and deleting baskets within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: Implements basket-related operations such as adding items, updating item quantities, transferring baskets between anonymous and logged-in users, and deleting baskets.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to a user's basket, creating a new basket if none exists for the user.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket by its ID after ensuring its existence.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Updates the quantities of items in a basket based on provided quantities, returning a result indicating success or not found.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers items from an anonymous basket to a user's basket, creating a new user basket if necessary, then deletes the anonymous basket.
